mostWorthwhile.text: Trapping inhaled material and then moving it toward the throat made the relationship between mucus and cilia concrete; the few particles continuing toward the air sacs also showed why another defense matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the already-working airway lining to the body was a predictable integration step, though it helped locate the defense in the larger model.

surprise.text: The macrophages could not be added directly to the moving lining; the compatibility feedback instead connected the lining to the body first.

arbitrary.text: That ordering initially felt unclear: the picture already showed microbes reaching the air sacs, so adding macrophages seemed purposeful before attaching the lining to the body.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how other immune defenses complement these incomplete barriers, although the combinations here were mostly straightforward.
